title: Signatures: Build signatures UI
desc: GET /api/v1/hr-forms-compliance/signatures exists but no page consumes it.

title: Templates: Create custom template and wire supersede
desc: Only seed-defaults and publish; no create/edit template or schema editor. API supports supersede action but UI has no Supersede button.

title: Routings: Template picker and stage management
desc: Stage form requires manual templateId entry. Only upsert-stage supported; no delete or reorder controls.

title: Submissions: Dynamic form render and e-signature audit trail
desc: Start submission collects IDs only; no form fields from template schema. No UI to view per-stage signatures. Reject uses window.prompt.

title: Submissions: Fix status filter and automate writeback
desc: Filter dropdown omits SUBMITTED. Writeback success/failure marked manually; no integrated writeback engine UI.

title: Certificate: Attestation UI and certificate export
desc: Sign sends hardcoded attestations array. No PDF/download or signed certificate viewer.

title: Dashboard: Loading/error states and KPI drill-down
desc: No loading spinner or error UI. KPI tiles not linked to filtered views.
